The off-label use of Donepezil to treat Lewy Body Dementia is linked to the use of Rivastigmine, a cholinesterase inhibitor with a known mechanism of action in AD. The indirect pathway from Rivastigmine to AD-NFT implies a possible role of cholinergic dysfunction in this condition. The final score of 0.5741 suggests a moderate level of support for this relationship, though it is not strong enough to definitively establish a causal link. The evidence is based on off-label use and pharmacological interactions, which may not fully capture the direct mechanisms of AD-NFT. Further research is needed to clarify the role of Donepezil in this specific form of AD.
